description: Search, browse, or fetch Research Square preprints by keyword, subject, article type, status, journal, date, URL or DOI.

abstractContains.description: Keep preprints whose abstract contains these words.
abstractContains.title: Abstract contains

articleType.description: Keep one article type. Required for mode=browseByType.
articleType.title: Article type

author.description: Keep preprints with this author name (substring match, e.g. 'Smith').
author.sectionDescription: Narrow results by author, title, abstract, subject, article type, status, journal or COVID-19 relevance.
author.title: Author name

detailLevel.description: listing = fastest, details adds abstract/keywords/authors/affiliations/PDF, metrics adds views/downloads, citations adds scite citation tallies.
detailLevel.sectionDescription: Each step costs one extra request per record. Citations are fetched in batches.
detailLevel.title: Detail level

dois.description: DOIs such as 10.21203/rs.3.rs-11849967/v1 (mode=byDoi). 10.1038/protex protocol DOIs resolve outside Research Square; use their article URL instead.
dois.title: DOIs

includeRelated.description: Add up to 5 related preprints per record using Research Square's own journal + first-subject sidebar query. Adds one request per record.
includeRelated.sectionDescription: Optional related-preprint list, matching the article page's own related-preprints sidebar.
includeRelated.title: Include related preprints

journal.description: Keep preprints linked to one journal or platform (site slug).

journal.title: Journal

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Runs above 10,000 are collected in date windows (newest first).
maxItems.sectionDescription: The run stops when it reaches maxItems or the source runs out.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to fetch. Search runs a keyword query, browseAll lists the newest preprints, the subject/type modes filter the catalog, and the URL/DOI modes fetch specific articles.
enumTitles: Fetch by article URL or ID
mode.sectionDescription: Pick a mode, then set only the filters that mode needs.
mode.title: Mode

onlyCovid.description: Keep only preprints in the site's COVID-19 collection.
onlyCovid.title: COVID-19 preprints only

postedAfter.sectionDescription: Limit by posting date. Large runs are collected in date windows because the site caps offsets at 10,000.
postedAfter.title: Posted after

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword search across titles, abstracts and keywords (mode=search). Use quotes for phrases.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Keyword search matches titles, abstracts and author keywords.
searchQuery.title: Search query

subjectArea.description: Browse one subject. Top-level categories (e.g. 'Agricultural Sciences') are expanded to all of their child subjects.
subjectArea.title: Subject area

subjectPath.description: Optional exact taxonomy path such as 'Health sciences/Oncology' for newer Nature-style records. Leave empty to use Subject area.
subjectPath.title: Subject path (advanced)

titleContains.description: Keep preprints whose title contains these words.
titleContains.title: Title contains

urls.description: Article URLs, bare IDs (rs-123), or DOI links. Supports /v1 and /latest URLs (mode=byUrl).
urls.sectionDescription: Paste article links, IDs or DOIs to fetch exact records.
urls.title: Article URLs or IDs
